_doc: Pi-IR projection of mcp_namespace_roundtrip/messages_sse.json — pi consumes the same SSE and emits a single toolCall block keeping the FLAT mcp__server__tool wire name verbatim. Pi does not split MCP namespaces (its consumer is Claude Code, which routes via the registered tool name string). XLI's projection helper (parse_flat_mcp_tool_name) splits the flat name into (namespace="mcp__clangd_rs", bare_name="analyze_symbol") at content_block_start. Closes RI-004 (tool_use FunctionCall lifecycle), RI-007 (MCP namespace split — ASYMMETRIC verdict), RI-025 (cross-wire FunctionCall.name consistency).
